variants.specifics: Brackenford: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Have you seen them? Nasty little thieves, ran off toward the ford? No? Oh, bother!

The Urchins got into the mill last night and took my amulet, the one with the blue stone. They've a hole in the old barrow, east of the ford. I wouldn't set foot in there for all the flour in Brackenford!

Would you get it back for me, kind sir? I'd pay you for your trouble.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: My amulet! Oh, you found it! Bless you, bless you! Here, take this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Recover Wenna's amulet from the Urchins.

guard.speaker: Garrick
guard.text: Halt! The north gate stays shut till Halvard says otherwise. Red Corwin's bandits own that road now.

shop.speaker: Dunstan
shop.text: Bandits up north, wolves in the woods... A body needs a good blade these days! Have a look.

townsfolk1.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk1.text: Wolves in the woods, Urchins in the barrow, bandits on the hill! What did we ever do to deserve this?

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: They say Red Corwin once robbed a whole wagon train with nothing but a stick and a very loud voice!

variants.specifics: Kroth: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Grenda
offer.text:
Scorpions! Scorpions in my mushroom cave! They came up out of the old tunnels when the dead started walking, and now they're eating my whole crop and stinging anybody who goes in there!

My cave is just west of the market. Kill the nasty things and I'll pay you well, I promise!

completion.speaker: Grenda
completion.text: All dead? Oh, thank goodness! My poor mushrooms! Here, take this gold, kind sir. You've earned every piece of it.

journal.text: Kill the Scorpions in Grenda's mushroom cave.

guard.speaker: Hask
guard.text: Halt! The Deep Gate is shut by order of Guildmaster Brummel. The dead are walking down there!

shop.speaker: Yorla
shop.text: Ah, a customer! With the dead walking again, everybody wants healing potions... so the price has gone up a little. Heh, heh, heh...

townsfolk1.speaker: Bettina
townsfolk1.text: Out of my way! This cart won't push itself!

townsfolk2.speaker: Olf
townsfolk2.text: Old Edda's been screaming about Urchins all morning. Somebody ought to help her.

variants.specifics: Gloam: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Those wretched Imps! They flew right in my window and made off with my Spyglass!

How am I to keep watch now? Without it I can't see the Undead coming till they're halfway up the ladders! The Imps nest in the Rotten Oak, west across the bog.

Would you get my Spyglass back for me, brave Adventurer? I'd make it worth your while.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: My Spyglass! You found it! Ha, ha! Now let those Undead try to sneak up on Gloam! Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Recover Fennick's Spyglass from the Imps in the Rotten Oak.

guard.speaker: Tobbin
guard.text: Halt! No one passes the Plank Gate. Mayor Grimbol's orders! There's Undead out in that bog, stranger, and plenty of 'em.

shop.speaker: Bulmer
shop.text: Welcome to the Soggy Toad, stranger! Pull up a stool. What'll it be?

townsfolk1.speaker: Nell
townsfolk1.text: Not now, please. My floor's flooding again.

townsfolk2.speaker: Hollis
townsfolk2.text: Mayor Grimbol hasn't set foot outside the Town Hall in a week. They say he sleeps under his desk with a pitchfork!

variants.specifics: Durnhelm: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Bodric
offer.text:
Bah! Giant Leeches! The cistern under the kitchens is crawling with the slimy things! I sent the potboy down for a bucket of water and he came back up screaming, with leeches stuck all over his legs!

If Malgrith's dead ever lay siege to us, this castle will need every drop in that cistern. And the soldiers won't go near it!

Clear 'em out and I'll make it worth your while.

completion.speaker: Bodric
completion.text: No more leeches? Ha! Thank you, lad! Here, take this gold. You earned every piece of it!

journal.text: Clear the Giant Leeches out of the cistern beneath the kitchens.

guard.speaker: Tobin
guard.text: Welcome to Durnhelm, stranger! No Undead has ever set foot inside these walls, and none ever will while the Iron Watch stands guard! The east gate stays shut, though. Commander Holgrim's orders.

shop.speaker: Brunwald
shop.text: Brunwald's Arms and Armor. Swords, shields, mail. What'll it be?

townsfolk1.speaker: Gaspar
townsfolk1.text: Commander Holgrim is the bravest man in Durnhelm! He once wrestled an Ogre in the courtyard and won!

townsfolk2.speaker: Bodric
townsfolk2.text: What? Sorry, I've got bread in the oven.

variants.specifics: Ostra: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Hulda
offer.text:
Thieves! Nasty little thieves! The Urchins crept down from the caves under Black Cliff last night and took my magic amulet right off my neck while I slept!

I can't go up there, not with my bad knees and the Undead about.

Would you get it back for me, kind sir? I'd be ever so grateful.

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text: My amulet! Oh, you found it! Bless you, bless you! Here, take these. It isn't much, but it's all an old fishwife has to give.

journal.text: Recover Hulda's amulet from the Urchins of Black Cliff.

guard.speaker: Brannoc
guard.text: Sorry, stranger. Nobody crosses the causeway without Mayor Odrick's say-so. The dead walk it after dark.

shop.speaker: Zebulin
shop.text: Ahh, a customer! With the dead walking about, you'll be wanting potions. Lots of potions! Zebulin has plenty.

townsfolk1.speaker: Dorrie
townsfolk1.text: Not now! I've got a whole basket of eels to skin.

townsfolk2.speaker: Pell
townsfolk2.text: Mayor Odrick hasn't set foot outside his house since the dead came up. Some mayor!

variants.specifics: Ardoth: cross-section: bounty_offer, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Hobb
offer.text:
Leeches! Great big slimy Leeches, in my lily pond behind the College! Ever since that Necromancer came all kinds of nasty things crawl up out of the water.

They ate every last frog in there and bit one of the students on the leg. Kill 'em off for me and I'll pay you good gold, I promise you that.

completion.speaker: Hobb
completion.text: They're gone? Really? Ha! Now maybe I can get some sleep. Here, 75 gold. You earned every piece of it!

journal.text: Kill the Leeches in Hobb's lily pond.

guard.speaker: Brannoc
guard.text: Halt! The west gate is shut by order of Archmaster Quellan. Skeletons walk the road out there.

shop.speaker: Bodkin
shop.text: Welcome to the Singed Owl! Pull up a stool and I'll pour you somethin' warm.

townsfolk1.speaker: Fennick
townsfolk1.text: Not now, stranger. I've got my own troubles.

townsfolk2.speaker: Pim
townsfolk2.text: Every night there are more Skeletons on the road. How long can the College hold out?

variants.specifics: Fort Skarn: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Elko
offer.text:
Blast it all! How am I supposed to watch the pass now?

The Urchins crept up the north wall last night and made off with my spyglass! A magic one, it is. They live down in the Ice Caves below the wall.

Without it, Kolgrath's Undead could be at the gate before anybody sees them! Will you get it back for me, young sir?

completion.speaker: Elko
completion.text: My spyglass! Ha, ha! I can see all the way to Kel Dorran again! Thank you, lad. Here, take this for your trouble.

journal.text: Recover Elko's spyglass from the Urchins in the Ice Caves.

guard.speaker: Tormod
guard.text: Halt! The East Gate is shut by order of Warden Brannoc. Nobody goes up the pass while the Undead are on it.

shop.speaker: Bodmar
shop.text: Welcome to Bodmar's Armory! Swords, shields, good thick armor. Can I help you?

townsfolk1.speaker: Ulla
townsfolk1.text: Cold, cold, cold! I haven't felt my toes since spring.

townsfolk2.speaker: Fitch
townsfolk2.text: Nibbs is in the cell again for cheating at dice. He'll talk your ear off if you let him.

variants.specifics: Vulmar: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Mott
offer.text:
Bah! Scorpions! The Slag Pits east of town are crawling with them. Ever since the Ogres took the Old Foundry, every kind of vermin is coming down off the mountain!

My mules won't go near the pits, and I've got ore to haul. Kill those Scorpions and I'll make it worth your while. That's fair, isn't it?

completion.speaker: Mott
completion.text: Dead? All of 'em? Ha! Wait till my mules hear about this! Here's 100 gold for you, stranger. You earned every piece.

journal.text: Kill the Scorpions in the Slag Pits for Mott.

guard.speaker: Hulgar
guard.text: Halt! Nobody goes up the mountain road. Mayor Dravik's orders. The Ogres would have you for supper!

shop.speaker: Sibba
shop.text: Heh, heh... A customer! Come in, come in! Potions, scrolls, spell books... just don't touch the green jar.

townsfolk1.speaker: Pell
townsfolk1.text: Can't talk now. These bellows won't pump themselves!

townsfolk2.speaker: Brom
townsfolk2.text: Keep your purse tied tight, stranger. The Imps will grab anything that shines.

variants.specifics: Kesrin: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Thurl
offer.text:
EH? Speak up! SPEAK UP!

It's no good, I can't hear a blessed thing. Those Imps flew down from Gallow Rock and snatched my ear trumpet right out of my hand!

You'll fetch it back for me, won't you, young sir? I'll make it worth your while!

completion.speaker: Thurl
completion.text: My trumpet! Ahhhh, I can hear the birds again! Thank you, young sir, thank you! Please, take this as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Retrieve Thurl's ear trumpet from the Imps of Gallow Rock.

guard.speaker: Dalt
guard.text: Halt! No one goes out the east gate. Mayor Fennick's orders! Ravek's Undead walk that road after dark.

shop.speaker: Bodger
shop.text: Come in, come in! Sit yerself down! The stew's hot and there's ale enough in the cellar to drown a whole army of Ogres!

townsfolk1.speaker: Wenzel
townsfolk1.text: What? Can't you see I'm busy?

townsfolk2.speaker: Lumm
townsfolk2.text: Going south? Keep your purse tied tight. The Imps of Gallow Rock will take anything that shines!

variants.specifics: Ostrel: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Gaffer Rudd
offer.text:
First the Ogres, and now Leeches! Great big slimy Leeches, crawled up out of the bog and into my cow pond! The cows won't go near the water and they've gone and stopped giving milk.

The pond's just past my barn, south of the village. You kill them horrid things and I'll pay you good gold for it, lad.

completion.speaker: Gaffer Rudd
completion.text: They're dead? All of 'em? Ha! The cows will be glad to hear it! Here, take this gold. You earned it.

journal.text: Kill the Giant Leeches in Gaffer Rudd's cow pond.

guard.speaker: Dobbs
guard.text: Halt! Nobody goes out the north gate. Mayor Bellock's orders. The Ogres would have you for supper before you got past the turnip fields!

shop.speaker: Brask
shop.text: Brask's Forge. Swords, axes, shields. Have a look.

townsfolk1.speaker: Nettie
townsfolk1.text: The Ogres ate my best milking cow! I cried for a week.

townsfolk2.speaker: Joss
townsfolk2.text: Can't stop to chat, stranger. Those turnips won't pick themselves!
